function statement(sql,args=[]){return {bind(...values){return statement(sql,values)},async all(){return {results:sqlite.prepare(sql).all(...args)}},async first(){return sqlite.prepare(sql).get(...args)||null},async run(){const r=sqlite.prepare(sql).run(...args);return {meta:{changes:Number(r.changes)}}}}}
const bucket=new Map();globalThis.__pllugoTestEnv={PLLUGO_OWNER_EMAIL:'owner@example.test',DB:{prepare:sql=>statement(sql),async batch(statements){sqlite.exec('BEGIN');try{const r=[];for(const s of statements)r.push(await s.run());sqlite.exec('COMMIT');return r}catch(e){sqlite.exec('ROLLBACK');throw e}}},BUCKET:{async put(key,body,options={}){bucket.set(key,{body,...options})},async head(key){return bucket.get(key)},async get(key){return bucket.get(key)}}};
